CYCLES vs EEVEE: Cycles ignores Light.volume_factor. StageSpot uses volume_factor 20 and every wash/key uses 0; without the patched build_lights (scratchpad/light/build_scene_patched.py: a volume-only twin with (vf-1)x energy, visible_volume_scatter=False for vf<=0) the beam is ~20x too faint and the washes fog the room in Cycles. EEVEE honours it natively but renders the darks at 0.55-0.7x: for EEVEE use world bg_strength 0.9, BlueWash_Shot3 3600 W and DS_Key ~600 W.
